faq.q: What is the price of plots for sale in Avadi?
faq.a: Prices start around ₹4,500–₹5,500 per sq.ft. for compact 600 sq.ft. units, scaling to ₹6,500+ for premium 2,400 sq.ft. corner plots.

faq.q: Is investing in plots in Avadi a good long-term decision?
faq.a: Yes — infrastructure growth and proximity to IT corridors support 12–15% annual appreciation, backed by CMDA and DTCP certification.

faq.q: What is the plot appreciation rate in Avadi?
faq.a: Rates have appreciated 12–15% yearly over the past 3–5 years, driven by metro extensions and industrial hubs in the surrounding areas.

faq.q: What is the stamp duty for buying land in Avadi?
faq.a: 7% of the market value for plots above ₹10 lakh, plus a 1% registry fee under Tamil Nadu rules. Women buyers receive a 1% rebate on CMDA-approved plots.

faq.q: Can I buy a plot in Avadi on EMI?
faq.a: Yes — flexible EMI options are available through bank tie-ups, covering up to 80% financing over 5–20 years at 8.5–10% interest.

faq.q: Can I get a home loan for buying a plot in Avadi?
faq.a: Major banks offer plot loans up to 75–80% of value for CMDA approved plots, at 8–9.5% interest and tenures up to 15 years.

faq.q: Are plots in Avadi CMDA or DTCP approved?
faq.a: All OmShakthy plots in Avadi are fully CMDA and DTCP certified, ensuring legal layouts, clear titles, and infrastructure compliance.

faq.q: What documents should I check before buying a plot in Avadi?
faq.a: CMDA/DTCP approval, encumbrance certificate (last 30 years), patta/chitta extract, sale deed, and survey sketch.

faq.q: How to avoid fraud when buying a plot in Avadi?
faq.a: Deal only with reputed developers, insist on site visits, get third-party legal checks, avoid cash deals, and run an encumbrance certificate search.

faq.q: Can NRIs buy plots in Avadi?
faq.a: Yes — NRIs can freely buy plots in Avadi for residential use via repatriable funds, per FEMA rules, with no restrictions on CMDA-approved plots.

faq.q: Is Avadi a good place to buy a plot?
